patterns.note: Dominant use of full-bleed, high-fashion photography as primary content sections, creating a gallery-like scroll experience where each image fills a significant portion of the viewport.
Minimalist, uppercase sans-serif for navigation and labels, contrasting with a larger, bold, wide sans-serif for the brand logo and section titles.

Stark black and white UI elements provide a clean, high-contrast backdrop, allowing the rich, earthy tones and textures of the product photography to be the primary source of color and visual interest.
The hero overlay text 'FIRST DROP JUST ARRIVED DISCOVER' fades out as the user scrolls past the initial viewport.
Each major content block is presented as a full-viewport-height image section, often with minimal text overlay, creating a sequential visual narrative rather than a traditional grid or card layout.

technique_notes: A fixed-position header maintains its presence at the top of the viewport, ensuring navigation and branding are always accessible.
Scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations or JavaScript-based opacity transitions cause the hero overlay text to fade out as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Full-bleed image sections are achieved by setting images as background elements or using image tags with object-fit: cover, ensuring they fill their container and adapt to various screen sizes while maintaining aspect ratio.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold geometric sans-serif for the logo, large bold sans-serif for section titles, and small uppercase sans-serif for navigation and labels, with standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp, with no visible rounding on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with large full-bleed image sections creating significant visual breaks, while internal text blocks maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive design is its strong reliance on full-bleed, high-fashion photography that acts as the primary content and navigation, creating a scrolling gallery experience. This visual-first approach, combined with a stark black and white UI, elevates the product presentation beyond typical e-commerce, focusing on artistic expression and brand mood.
